title: Three Years and One Short Clock
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：period　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 period 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the keeper ① marked the period that no traveller in the tower would have counted, and he said the marking was the whole of the year. The ② period, meaning the time itself and not the clock, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a period, he said, is the only thing in a tower that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ period in that tower had the same short clock beside it, and the ④ period at the far stair, meaning the bell they kept for the children to ring and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A period, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the keeper said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the period was the whole of the matter, meaning the change and not the time. The ⑥ period, meaning the change and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; period, he said, is either something you mark or the only word that means both a time and a change. He said the change is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ period had become a line in a calendar, and the calendar had become an argument about the short clock. The ⑧ period of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in January, was one tower and three years of counting; period, he said, is either the bell at the far stair or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ period I remember is the time counted in the calendar, which closed in 1984 and is still counted as the quietest in the tower. A ⑩ period, my mother said in 1986, is the only time that improves by being counted; every period, she said, is a change that has agreed to look like a time. She said the change was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 时期；一段时间（指钟楼里每一段旁边的那一段）
B. n. 时期；一段时间（指那段时期本身，与小小的座钟相对）
C. 固定搭配：mark the period 划分这一段时期
D. n. 时期；一段时间（指留给孩子们敲的那一口）
E. n. 时期之事（抽象总称，指一处钟楼的时期之事）
F. n. 时期；一段时间（指年历里写到、被清点的那一段）
G. n. 时期、更迭（指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 更迭（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: marked the period that no traveller in the tower would have counted
The period, meaning the time itself and not the clock
the period at the far stair
the period was the whole of the matter
the period had become a line in a calendar
The period of the whole thing
A period, my mother said in 1986

answers.why: mark the period 意为“划分这一段时期”，1977 年那位守夜人把钟楼里没有一位过路人肯清点的一段时期做了一遍。
period 意为“时期；一段时间”，指那段时期本身而不是小小的座钟，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被清点。
period 意为“时期；一段时间”，指钟楼里每一段旁边的那一段，每一段旁边都有同一座小小的座钟。
period 意为“时期；一段时间”，指最远那道旋梯的留给孩子们敲的那一口，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
period 意为“时期、更迭”，指一件事里人人都等却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这段更迭就是那件事的全部。
period 意为“更迭”，指人人都等却无人提起的那样东西而不是那段时期，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
period 意为“时期；一段时间”，指年历里写到、被清点的那一段，到 1982 年这一段成了年历里的一行。
period 意为“时期之事”，守夜人一月写道，整件事的时期之事是一处钟楼和三个年头的清点。
period 意为“时期；一段时间”，我记得的是年历里清点过的那一段，1984 年走完了，至今仍被说成钟楼里最安静的一段。
period 为抽象总称，母亲 1986 年说，时期是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的时期。
